<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Publish an X.509 certificate on an organization"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1/organization/{organizationId}/anchor/certificate"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Publishes an X.509 certificate (PEM) on the virtual blockchain of an organization owned by the wallet, as `{ __certificate__: { type: "PEM", pem } }`. The microblock is signed by the wallet and its fees are paid by the account the wallet is attached to.
